sources.quote: And Chisone is conditional, the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) has conditional qualification, so it may not get new business or new parts now. Moving BR-310 shipments to a different receiving plant is new business. No later document shows the status has been lifted.

sources.quote: found at incoming inspection on BR-310.

findings.why: The 8D on cracks in EN AW-6082 brackets is still open. The root cause is under investigation and the corrective action is not verified. It was raised on BR-310 itself, and the supplier is the one proposed as the BR-310 source.

sources.quote: Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only.

findings.why: No controlled approval record covers SUP-C for BR-310 at Beinasco (PLT-BEI), and no document names the customer of BR-310. The absence of a record is not proof that the source is unapproved. A person must confirm whether a current release exists for this part, plant and customer.
